missions.name: Form Check
missions.goal: Learn the basic Johnny5k rhythm
missions.narrative: Johnny brings you to the quiet end of the yard, where trust is earned in small controlled moments and every mistake echoes louder than any show of force.

encounter_seeds.title: The Chalk Ring
encounter_seeds.objective: steady the practice circle
encounter_seeds.threat: the barked corrections of the yard master
encounter_seeds.landmark: the chalk-scraped practice square
encounter_seeds.hazard: dust keeps sliding under careless feet and every correction carries across the yard
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the ring breaks under you the whole yard will remember exactly how
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the yard master keeps circling just outside the ring, waiting to pounce on the first lazy line
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: chalk dust hangs in the warm air and every boot scrape sounds louder than it should
encounter_seeds.pressure: every mistake is being called out loud enough for the whole yard to hear
encounter_seeds.success_turn: the circle steadies and the yard master loses a little of the advantage
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the chalk ring starts feeling like your ground instead of his lesson
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the corrections start landing faster than you can answer them
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the whole ring is one shouted correction away from collapsing under you
encounter_seeds.transition: the circle settles, but the center lane is already waiting for a cleaner answer

encounter_seeds.title: The Center Lane
encounter_seeds.objective: prove you can keep the line clean under scrutiny
encounter_seeds.threat: the instructor's unbroken attention
encounter_seeds.landmark: the sun-beaten center lane
encounter_seeds.hazard: there is nowhere to hide a mistake once you step into the open strip
encounter_seeds.stakes: if you lose the lane here the yard decides you are all show and no command
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the instructor stands at the far post with his arms folded, never blinking
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: sparring wood cracks nearby and the whole yard goes quiet whenever you move
encounter_seeds.pressure: the next mistake will draw the whole yard onto you
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you make the lane look simple and force the scrutiny to ease
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the lane starts opening end to end as the whole yard runs out of faults to call
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the lane keeps tightening under the instructor's eye
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the center lane is one stumble away from becoming a public failure
encounter_seeds.transition: the lane opens, but the yard is already shaping the next demand

outcomes.victory: The yard accepts your answer, and {encounter_proof}
outcomes.partial: You keep control long enough to finish the lesson, but the {encounter_label} still waits for cleaner command.
outcomes.failure: The lesson slips out of your hands before you can {encounter_objective}.

missions.name: Marker Run
missions.goal: Visit the outer flags and return before the bell
missions.narrative: The yard master sends you toward the outer flags before the dust from the last drill has settled. The route is short, but it only belongs to you if you come back with your breathing and nerve intact.

encounter_seeds.title: The Outer Flags
encounter_seeds.objective: touch the far markers and turn the route back in your favor
encounter_seeds.threat: the bell counting down from the yard wall
encounter_seeds.landmark: the wind-beaten flags at the yard wall
encounter_seeds.hazard: loose gravel and the turn itself keep trying to spill your pace wide
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the flags own the turn the return lane belongs to the bell
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the wall bell keeps hammering time against your ribs from overhead
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: dust stings the shins and the bell note keeps bouncing off the stone
encounter_seeds.pressure: every second the bell keeps ringing makes the return path feel longer
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you hit the flags cleanly and steal a breath back from the clock
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the far markers start feeling claimed and the route back finally belongs to you
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the bell keeps chewing up the route while the turn stays awkward
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the turn at the outer flags is starting to vanish under the bell's pressure
encounter_seeds.transition: the far turn is yours, but the return sprint is already waiting

encounter_seeds.title: The Return Lane
encounter_seeds.objective: bring the route home before the bell closes it
encounter_seeds.threat: the yard's shortening clock
encounter_seeds.landmark: the finish lane back toward the drill square
encounter_seeds.hazard: the ground feels longer on the way back and the air never quite fills the lungs
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the lane breaks your return the whole run becomes a lesson in fading late
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the clock keeps hunting your shoulder instead of fading behind you
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: the finish markers shimmer in heat and every breath comes back rough
encounter_seeds.pressure: the finish is narrowing with every breath you waste
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you make the lane feel shorter and force the bell to chase you instead
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the whole return lane starts collapsing toward the finish line under your pace
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the lane keeps stretching while the bell stays right on top of you
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the finish is one ragged breath from sealing itself off
encounter_seeds.transition: the lane breaks open, but the yard has already marked the next test

outcomes.victory: You return before the bell can claim the yard, and {encounter_proof}
outcomes.partial: You make it back on time, but the {encounter_label} nearly steals the finish from you.
outcomes.failure: The bell claims the yard before you can {encounter_objective}.

missions.name: First Steel
missions.goal: Turn exercise into adventure fantasy
missions.threat: Straw soldiers and light sparring partners
missions.narrative: Wooden weapons crack, straw armor shudders, and shouted cues turn the yard into a first battlefield. Nothing here is meant to kill you, but all of it is meant to find out whether you flinch.

encounter_seeds.title: The Straw Line
encounter_seeds.objective: break the straw line before it can harden
encounter_seeds.threat: the first rush of sparring partners
encounter_seeds.landmark: the straw men packed shoulder to shoulder near the yard rail
encounter_seeds.hazard: split reed shafts and flying splinters keep cluttering the footing
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the line hardens the yard will read hesitation in every next move
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the sparring partners keep darting in and out behind the straw front
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: straw dust floats in the sunlight and practice blades clap like dry bones
encounter_seeds.pressure: hesitation gives the whole line time to crowd you back
encounter_seeds.success_turn: the line shudders and the first gap starts to show
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the straw line starts folding in on itself and exposing a real opening
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the line keeps reforming every time you fail to press it
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the whole line is one missed push away from swallowing the opening again
encounter_seeds.transition: the line gives a little, but the raised platform is already turning into the real test

encounter_seeds.title: The Raised Platform
encounter_seeds.objective: hold the platform and force the duel to stay yours
encounter_seeds.threat: the captain's favored trainee
encounter_seeds.landmark: the scarred sparring platform above the yard
encounter_seeds.hazard: the boards flex under hard pivots and the edge never stops looming
encounter_seeds.stakes: if you lose the platform the crowd and the duel both tilt away from you
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the favored trainee keeps stalking the center board and daring you to overreach
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: boots drum on the planks and the rail crowd sucks in breath with every shift
encounter_seeds.pressure: one bad step will hand the platform and the crowd to the other side
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you take the stronger footing and make the platform answer to you
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the platform starts tilting fully toward your side and the crowd feels it
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the platform keeps shifting toward the other fighter's rhythm
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the platform is one bad step from throwing the whole duel away
encounter_seeds.transition: the platform steadies, but the captains are already choosing the next pressure point

outcomes.victory: The straw line gives way and the yard finally feels like a true campaign. The {encounter_label} breaks your way because you {encounter_objective}.
outcomes.partial: You force the line to hesitate, but the {encounter_label} still answers every opening with pressure.
outcomes.failure: The first clash gets inside your timing before you can {encounter_objective}.

missions.name: Cadence Yard
missions.goal: Learn pacing, rests, and mission completion
missions.narrative: The yard stops forgiving wasted breath. Drill captains watch the clock, the rests, and the look in your face between efforts, waiting to see whether your discipline holds when the rhythm turns against you.

encounter_seeds.title: The Captains' Whistle
encounter_seeds.objective: hold command of the opening circuit
encounter_seeds.threat: the captains' whistle cutting every rest short
encounter_seeds.landmark: the painted opening circuit beneath the watchtower
encounter_seeds.hazard: the whistle keeps cutting recovery short and forcing the lungs to catch up mid-stride
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the whistle owns the count the whole circuit becomes their lesson instead of your ground
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the captains pace the rail with whistles already at their lips
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: metal notes slash the air and the packed dirt smells hot under the sun
encounter_seeds.pressure: the whistle is trying to take your breathing away before the circuit belongs to you
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you keep the circuit under your own count and deny the whistle its hold
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the whole opening circuit starts running on your count instead of theirs
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the whistle keeps breaking your rhythm before you can settle it
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the first lane is one broken breath from turning entirely against you
encounter_seeds.transition: the first lane holds, but the timed turn is already about to bite down

encounter_seeds.title: The Timed Turn
encounter_seeds.objective: carry clean control through the hard turn
encounter_seeds.threat: the circuit tightening every time you hesitate
encounter_seeds.landmark: the sharp turn marker at the back end of the yard
encounter_seeds.hazard: the pivot comes too fast and punishes any breath taken half-late
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the turn breaks your rhythm the rest of the circuit will punish you for it
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the circuit itself seems to lean into the bend and wait for you to lose balance
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: dust spirals at the marker and every exhale feels visible
encounter_seeds.pressure: if the turn gets ahead of you the whole circuit will start running you instead
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you come through the turn clean and make the circuit follow your pace
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the hard turn starts straightening under your tempo and the full circuit finally obeys
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the turn keeps kicking the tempo out from under you
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the timed turn is one ugly lapse from flipping the entire circuit onto you
encounter_seeds.transition: the turn clears, but the final lane is already demanding a harder answer

outcomes.victory: You finish the circuit with the tempo still under your command. The {encounter_label} never fully settles because you {encounter_objective}.
outcomes.partial: You complete the work, but the {encounter_label} exposes every place where your rhythm still leaks control.
outcomes.failure: The captains keep the pressure on until the {encounter_label} turns before you can {encounter_objective}.

missions.name: Captain of the Yard
missions.goal: Pass the first real confidence test and earn the road forward
missions.narrative: The captain watches you with the patience of someone who has seen brave people come apart at the exact moment their early confidence burns off. This is where the yard decides whether you can keep answering once the easy certainty is gone.
missions.workout_feel: Short-form full workout with clear instruction and low punishment

encounter_seeds.title: The Trial Lane
encounter_seeds.objective: survive the captain's opening read without yielding control
encounter_seeds.threat: the captain's probing tempo
encounter_seeds.landmark: the long trial lane laid out beneath the captain's banner
encounter_seeds.hazard: the open ground gives every weakness nowhere to hide
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the captain reads you cleanly here the road forward closes in public
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the captain prowls just off-center, testing range without ever committing first
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: banner cloth cracks overhead and the watching yard falls to a hard silence
encounter_seeds.pressure: the captain only needs one clean read on your weakness to own the whole lane
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you deny the first read and make the captain work harder for every inch
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the captain's early read starts breaking apart and the lane begins answering to you
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the captain keeps forcing you toward the weakest part of the lane
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the trial lane is one exposed weakness from belonging to the captain outright
encounter_seeds.transition: the lane stays alive, but the finishing exchange is already being drawn tighter

encounter_seeds.title: The Captain's Mark
encounter_seeds.objective: take the mark and prove the road belongs to you
encounter_seeds.threat: the captain's final demand for control
encounter_seeds.landmark: the painted mark at the lane's dead center
encounter_seeds.hazard: the final approach offers no cover and no second clean chance
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the mark rejects you the whole yard will carry that memory longer than any victory
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the captain keeps hovering over the mark like he already owns the right to it
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: sweat darkens the paint and every footfall seems to land on the whole yard's nerves
encounter_seeds.pressure: if you hesitate now the whole yard will know exactly where you broke
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you take the mark cleanly and force the captain to acknowledge it
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the mark starts feeling inevitable and the whole yard can see whose road this is
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the mark keeps drifting out of reach while the captain closes in
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the captain's mark is one falter away from becoming proof against you
encounter_seeds.transition: the mark is yours, but the road beyond the yard is already calling the next danger forward

outcomes.victory: You earn the road beyond the yard. In {mission_name}, the {encounter_label} breaks your way and you {encounter_objective}.
outcomes.partial: The captain sends you back to sharpen the weak points, but the {encounter_label} bends just enough for your path to stay open.
outcomes.failure: The captain makes you yield the field after the {encounter_label} turns before you can {encounter_objective}.

missions.name: Shadows in the Streets
missions.goal: Establish tone
missions.narrative: The streets of Grim Hollow are silent in the way ruined places are silent, as if the village is holding its breath to hear whether you belong here. Then the fog shifts, and shapes begin to move inside it.
missions.threat: Shamblers and weak but numerous undead

encounter_seeds.title: The Market Crossroad
encounter_seeds.objective: hold the market crossroad long enough for the doors to bar
encounter_seeds.threat: the first shambler wave
encounter_seeds.landmark: the shuttered market square beneath hanging signboards
encounter_seeds.hazard: fog and overturned stalls break sightlines while side streets keep vomiting dead into the square
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the crossroad falls the doors never bar and the first houses are lost
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the shamblers keep folding into the square from every lane, not fast but never stopping
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: wet fog clings to the teeth and loose shutters bang somewhere unseen
encounter_seeds.pressure: every side street is feeding more dead toward the square
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you force the first bodies away from the market stalls and buy the village a breath
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the whole crossroad starts opening all the way through and the square remembers how to breathe
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the dead keep crawling through the fog and reaching for the square
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the market crossroad is one bad exchange from disappearing under the dead again
encounter_seeds.transition: the crossroad opens, but the grave bell is already starting to ring farther in

encounter_seeds.title: The Grave Bell
encounter_seeds.objective: reach the grave bell before it calls a larger wave
encounter_seeds.threat: the dead pressing up the chapel lane
encounter_seeds.landmark: the chapel lane running straight to the grave bell
encounter_seeds.hazard: the narrow lane funnels every rush toward the rope while the bell sways just beyond easy reach
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the bell sounds full the whole street belongs to the dead again
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the dead keep piling up the lane, shoving one another forward toward the rope
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: the rope creaks above the fog and old chapel stone leaks cold
encounter_seeds.pressure: if the bell gets a full toll the whole street will belong to the dead again
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you get close enough to the rope to turn the lane in your favor
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the bell rope starts feeling like a live answer in your hands instead of theirs
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the lane keeps filling while the bell hangs just beyond your reach
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the bell is one full toll from giving the whole street back to the dead
encounter_seeds.transition: the bell is within reach, but the square behind you is still not safe

outcomes.victory: The first wave falls away and Grim Hollow sees that someone is finally willing to answer the dead. The {encounter_label} breaks because you {encounter_objective}.
outcomes.partial: You buy the street a breath of safety, but the {encounter_label} still waits in the fog around the next corner.
outcomes.failure: The dead reclaim the street before you can {encounter_objective}.

missions.name: The Burning Chapel
missions.goal: Raise urgency
missions.narrative: Flames claw through the chapel rafters and throw frantic light across the square. Something inside the fire refuses to burn, and the whole village seems to know it is waiting for you.

encounter_seeds.title: The Burning Nave
encounter_seeds.objective: cut a path through the burning nave
encounter_seeds.threat: the rushing dead inside the chapel
encounter_seeds.landmark: the chapel nave split by fallen pews and fire
encounter_seeds.hazard: sparks rain from the rafters and burning beams keep closing the lane without warning
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the nave seals the chapel becomes a furnace and a tomb together
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the rushing dead keep using flame and falling timber as cover for their lunges
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: smoke claws at the throat and firelight flashes off wet teeth
encounter_seeds.pressure: the rafters are falling fast enough to trap you with the dead if you stall
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you carve a lane through the fire and make the rush hesitate
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the whole nave starts opening in strips of firelight and the rush finally breaks around you
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the flames and the dead keep folding the nave shut around you
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the burning nave is one collapsing rafter from becoming a sealed grave
encounter_seeds.transition: the nave opens, but the altar shadow is already starting to move

encounter_seeds.title: The Altar Shadow
encounter_seeds.objective: drag the altar shadow into the open
encounter_seeds.threat: the thing refusing to burn behind the altar
encounter_seeds.landmark: the cracked altar drowned in orange light
encounter_seeds.hazard: heat shimmer and collapsing icon screens keep hiding the thing behind the altar
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the shadow keeps its cover the chapel fire turns fully to its side
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the hidden thing keeps baiting you closer, then slipping deeper behind the altar blaze
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: wax runs across stone like blood and every ember snap sounds too close
encounter_seeds.pressure: every moment you give it lets the whole chapel burn harder in its favor
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you force the altar shadow to reveal itself and lose some of its cover
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the altar stops protecting it and the whole chapel starts throwing its hiding places away
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the altar shadow keeps using flame and panic to stay hidden
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the altar is one missed answer from giving the whole fire back to the thing behind it
encounter_seeds.transition: the altar breaks open, but the village is already feeling the cost outside

outcomes.victory: The fire stops serving them and starts looking like your warning to the village. The {encounter_label} stays yours because you {encounter_objective}.
outcomes.partial: You blunt the rush inside the chapel, but the {encounter_label} snaps back every time the flames surge.
outcomes.failure: The burning pressure swallows your timing before you can {encounter_objective}.

missions.name: The Graveyard Watcher
missions.goal: Build fatigue pressure
missions.narrative: The graves have been opened from the wrong side, and the air over the stones feels strained, as if the whole cemetery is waiting for one clean mistake. Something patient watches from beyond the markers.

encounter_seeds.title: The Broken Stones
encounter_seeds.objective: hold the path between the broken stones
encounter_seeds.threat: the graveyard watcher circling just out of sight
encounter_seeds.landmark: the broken path between tilted grave markers
encounter_seeds.hazard: loose stone and sunken earth keep dragging at the footing
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the watcher closes the ring here the whole graveyard becomes its hunting ground
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the watcher keeps circling outside the fog line, choosing patience over a clean reveal
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: dew clings to cracked marble and the air smells of wet soil turned too recently
encounter_seeds.pressure: the longer you let the watcher choose the angle the heavier the whole graveyard becomes
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you keep the path open and force the watcher to circle wider
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the path between the stones starts holding under your will and the watcher runs out of easy angles
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the watcher keeps turning the stones into a slower, meaner trap
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the graveyard path is one patient mistake from closing into a full ring around you
encounter_seeds.transition: the path stays open, but the mausoleum gate is already drawing the next test forward

encounter_seeds.title: The Mausoleum Gate
encounter_seeds.objective: reach the mausoleum gate before the watcher closes the circle
encounter_seeds.threat: the watcher finally pressing close enough to strike
encounter_seeds.landmark: the iron mausoleum gate at the cemetery's heart
encounter_seeds.hazard: narrow lanes of stone and hedge keep collapsing into blind angles
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the gate disappears behind the circle the cemetery wins the night
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the watcher finally cuts closer, trying to herd you away from the gate with each pass
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: rust flakes under the fingers and every hinge whisper feels like a warning
encounter_seeds.pressure: if the circle closes here you will be fighting the whole graveyard for every step
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you get the gate in sight and make the watcher spend its patience
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the gate starts feeling reachable and the watcher's circle finally loosens around it
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the circle keeps shrinking while the gate stays just out of reach
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the mausoleum gate is one narrowing turn from vanishing behind the circle
encounter_seeds.transition: the gate is almost yours, but the descent beyond it is already awake

outcomes.victory: The watcher loses patience before you lose your nerve. In {mission_name}, the {encounter_label} gives way because you {encounter_objective}.
outcomes.partial: You hold through the graveyard drag, but the {encounter_label} remains heavy and unfinished among the stones.
outcomes.failure: Fatigue lets the graveyard settle against you before you can {encounter_objective}.

missions.name: The Hollow Well
missions.goal: Build toward the boss reveal
missions.narrative: At the center of the village, the old well drops into a darkness that feels occupied rather than empty. The deeper truth of Grim Hollow is waiting below, and it already knows you are overhead.

encounter_seeds.title: The Well Square
encounter_seeds.objective: clear the square around the well
encounter_seeds.threat: the corrupted villagers surging between the houses
encounter_seeds.landmark: the village square crowded around the old well
encounter_seeds.hazard: collapsed carts and bodies in the lane keep ruining clean movement around the curb
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the square belongs to the surge the source below stays hidden and fed
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the corrupted villagers keep washing in from porches and alleys, driven by something below the stones
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: well water glistens black and the square reeks of damp rot and lantern smoke
encounter_seeds.pressure: every surge keeps trying to push you away from the one place that matters
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you hold the square long enough to make the villagers break around you
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the square begins to clear in full and the well starts standing exposed at last
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the square keeps flooding with bodies every time you try to settle it
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the well square is one failed stand from drowning under bodies again
encounter_seeds.transition: the square opens, but the descent is already calling something worse upward

encounter_seeds.title: The Well Lip
encounter_seeds.objective: take the lip of the well and force the source into the open
encounter_seeds.threat: the pressure coming up from the dark below
encounter_seeds.landmark: the slick stone lip of the village well
encounter_seeds.hazard: the stones sweat underfoot and something below keeps buckling the edge at the worst moment
encounter_seeds.stakes: if you lose the lip the dark below keeps drawing the whole village inward
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the pressure from below keeps timing its surges to upset your footing rather than meet you cleanly
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: cold breath rises from the shaft and the rope creaks against ancient stone
encounter_seeds.pressure: if you lose the lip now the whole village will keep feeding the thing below it
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you claim the edge of the well and deny the dark its hiding place
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the whole lip starts holding under your command and the thing below loses its cover
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the dark below keeps buckling the ground and stealing your footing
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the well lip is one broken step from dropping the whole fight back into the dark
encounter_seeds.transition: the well lip is yours, but the chamber below is already waiting

outcomes.victory: You reach the true descent with your nerve intact. The {encounter_label} opens and the source can no longer hide beneath the village.
outcomes.partial: You force a path to the well, but the {encounter_label} still closes around the descent in violent bursts.
outcomes.failure: The pressure around the well buckles your progress before you can {encounter_objective}.

missions.name: The Necromancer of Hollow
missions.goal: Confront the source beneath the well
missions.narrative: You descend beneath the well and enter a chamber where the air itself feels claimed. The necromancer is already waiting, calm in the knowledge that everything above has been shaped to wear you down before this final answer.
missions.workout_feel: Full workout structure with buildup sets leading into a final confrontation

encounter_seeds.title: The Bone Dais
encounter_seeds.objective: break the necromancer's hold on the bone dais
encounter_seeds.threat: the necromancer's first wave of dead guardians
encounter_seeds.landmark: the bone-stacked dais at the chamber center
encounter_seeds.hazard: rattling bone pillars and necrotic mist keep distorting the floor around the platform
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the dais stands untouched the chamber itself will keep fighting for him
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the guardians keep screening the dais while the necromancer watches for the exact lapse he wants
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: old marrow dust hangs in the torchlight and the chamber hums with grave magic
encounter_seeds.pressure: every moment the dais stays his lets the chamber itself fight for him
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you shake the dais hard enough to make his control flicker
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the dais starts giving way under him and the chamber finally stops answering cleanly to his will
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the dais keeps feeding the dead while the necromancer stays untouched
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the bone dais is one lost exchange from sealing the whole chamber back under his control
encounter_seeds.transition: the dais cracks, but the ritual circle behind it is already waking up

encounter_seeds.title: The Ritual Circle
encounter_seeds.objective: collapse the ritual circle and force the necromancer to stand alone
encounter_seeds.threat: the necromancer's remaining ritual power
encounter_seeds.landmark: the chalked ritual ring burning with corpse-light
encounter_seeds.hazard: each pulse of the sigils reshapes the floor and steals your timing for a breath
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the circle completes another full pulse the chamber returns to his control
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the necromancer keeps feeding the ring fragments of power and retreating behind its edge

encounter_seeds.pressure: one clean lapse will let the whole arena tilt permanently her way
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you deny the first pass and force the Matron to fight you in clearer space
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the blade canopy starts losing its cover for her and the duel finally sharpens into your sightlines
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the canopy keeps hiding her best angles while your own keep vanishing
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the blade canopy is one clean lapse from turning the whole arena to her side forever
encounter_seeds.transition: the center line holds, but the root throne behind her is already waking up

encounter_seeds.title: The Root Throne
encounter_seeds.objective: take the root throne and end the Wilds' hold on the duel
encounter_seeds.threat: the Matron drawing the whole nest into her final exchange
encounter_seeds.landmark: the twisted throne grown from the heart-root of the nest
encounter_seeds.hazard: the floor buckles with living roots and poisoned barbs whenever control slips
encounter_seeds.stakes: if the throne answers her the whole Wilds fight beside her
encounter_seeds.enemy_posture: the Matron keeps drawing the nest tighter around the throne with every feint
encounter_seeds.sensory_detail: roots throb underfoot and venom beads like dew along the bark
encounter_seeds.pressure: if the throne keeps answering her the whole forest will keep fighting at her shoulder
encounter_seeds.success_turn: you force the throne to answer your timing and make the Wilds hesitate
encounter_seeds.advance_turn: the root throne starts turning under your claim and the Wilds begin to hesitate with it
encounter_seeds.struggle_turn: the throne keeps feeding her clean escapes and uglier angles
encounter_seeds.crisis_turn: the root throne is one lost exchange from calling the whole Wilds back to her side
encounter_seeds.transition: the throne turns, but the Wilds still need one last command to break

outcomes.victory: The hidden paths belong to you and the Wilds finally whisper your name with respect. The {encounter_label} breaks because you {encounter_objective}.
outcomes.partial: The Matron fades into deeper forest, and the {encounter_label} stays unresolved beneath the canopy.
outcomes.failure: The forest closes behind you, and the {encounter_label} turns escape into the only victory left.
